name: ab-test-playbook
// why this exists: CI runs the test suite on Python 3.12 and lints the shell layer with
shellcheck. A contributor whose local Python is older, or who has no
shellcheck, finds that out from a red build rather than from their own
terminal. This container is the same two things, nothing more — there are
no runtime dependencies to install because the scripts are stdlib-only.
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y shellcheck
